subject: MSA redlines + signer delegation for Coupa onboarding — PO split clause

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medsys.com>

Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@medsys.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coupa onboarding — MSA redline and PO split requirement

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Attached is our intake packet plus the MSA with a handful of edits highlighted (MSA_redline_v3.pdf). Two items I want to call out up front so we don't miss them during portal activation:

- MedSys requires a signer-delegation matrix (we've attached a sample). Can you confirm Redwood can accept delegated signers if the order form has conditional approvers?
- Our procurement platform splits larger contracts into multiple PO releases ("PO split") for accounting reasons. We need the Order Form to state the accepted PO-splitting behavior and that split POs will map to a single Order Form.

Can you route this to legal + onboarding and let me know expected timing? We are aiming to finish enrollment before the end of the month so our SSO/Coupa connector can go live in September.

Attachments: MSA_redline_v3.pdf, OrderForm_PO_Split_Spec.xlsx

Best,
Elaine Park
Vendor Enablement Lead, MedSys Health
Elaine.Park@medsys.com

Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding — MSA redline and PO split requirement

Thanks Elaine — got the packet. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Jordan (portal ops) to pick this up. Quick answers: we can support a signer matrix during onboarding, but legal will need to confirm scope for delegated signers; and Coupa can accept multiple release POs mapped to one Order Form, though there are edge cases for invoicing and PO acknowledgement we should confirm.

Kimberly/Jordan — could you review the MSA_redline_v3.pdf and the PO split spec and flag any gating items by EOD Wednesday? If there are redlines that materially change payment or termination mechanics, flag for escalation.

Mina
Head of Vendor Programs
Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Coupa onboarding — MSA redline and PO split requirement

Mina/Jordan — I reviewed the MSA_redline_v3.pdf and the PO split spec. Summary of legal takeaways:

1) Signer delegation: we can accept a signer-delegation matrix for onboarding provided MedSys confirms a single contracting counterparty and the delegated roles are documented in the Order Form or an addendum. I redlined Section 2.1 to require that authority mapping be attached to the Order Form. (See attached redline and signature_matrix.png)

2) PO split: the requested language on mapping multiple PO releases to one Order Form is acceptable, but we should include clear invoicing rules: (a) Redwood will accept split POs if each PO references the Order Form ID, and (b) invoicing must reference the specific PO number for payment reconciliation. I added language to the Order Form exhibit.

3) Liability/payment: a couple of Elaine's edits expand indemnity and payment timing; I proposed a carve-out to preserve our standard net-45 terms for split POs.

Next steps: Jordan, can you advise if the Coupa connector will allow us to enforce the "Order Form ID" required field on PO creation? If not, we should ask MedSys procurement to add a required field or accept our mapping playbook.

Attachments: MSA_redline_v3_legal_comments.pdf, signature_matrix.png, OrderForm_PO_Split_Spec_annotated.xlsx

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: MedSys Legal <legal@medsys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@medsys.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement@medsys.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding — MSA redline and PO split requirement

Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick review. Attached is a short counter-proposal from our side. A few clarifications:

- For signer delegation, MedSys prefers to keep delegation allowance in the MSA (rather than the Order Form) so it applies consistently across multiple orders. We can supply a signed delegation matrix during onboarding and confirm the contracting counterparty.
- On split POs: we can ensure each PO includes an Order Form reference field but cannot guarantee finance will always populate a free-text field at creation. Can Redwood accept a mapping rule where we send a linking CSV during each billing cycle if PO metadata is incomplete?

We believe these alternatives preserve both parties' controls and will not delay activation. If acceptable, we can finalize a short amendment rather than a full MSA rewrite.

Regards,
Ari Mendoza
Senior Counsel, MedSys Health
legal@medsys.com

Attachments: MedSys_counter_proposal.pdf

Elaine/Ari — thanks for the proposals and the turnaround. Agreed path forward:

1) Redwood legal will accept a short amendment that: (a) permits signer delegation (MSA clause) and (b) documents the Order Form ID mapping approach as a contract exhibit.
2) MedSys will provide a signed delegation matrix during onboarding and commit to including the Order Form reference on POs where possible. If the reference is missing, MedSys will deliver a linking CSV at billing time (works for us with reconciliations).
3) Jordan: please confirm Coupa connector config and whether we need an invoice-run workaround for missing PO metadata. If that's a blocker, we will queue a limited gating task for ops.

I'll prepare the short amendment draft for signature and share with Ari and Elaine by EOD Friday. If anyone needs to escalate to procurement or finance approvals, flag now.

Thanks,
